stories.title: Replacement A494 River Dee Bridge put back to give new Welsh Government time to consider scheme
stories.summary: Work on the replacement A494 River Dee Bridge is now not expected to start until the end of 2027, after the timetable was changed to give the new Welsh Government time to consider the scheme. stories.title: Flintshire councillors asked to order investigation into £8.25m Catholic super school funding decision
stories.summary: Flintshire councillors will be asked to order an investigation into who decided the council should pay the full £8.25 million local share of a proposed new Catholic school. stories.title: Council tax revaluation delayed again as £80m support bill proves too costly
stories.summary: Council tax bands in Wales will stay based on 2003 property values for longer, after the Welsh Government paused plans for a revaluation.
